title: Local headless procedural 3D proof and Harness V4 provider
objective: Install the verified Studio source snapshot on the owner's Windows PC and add an offline local headless MCP that builds actual editable Blender/GLB scenes, renders review views and binds evidence to an isolated Harness V4-compatible static provider.
forbidden_paths: all existing episode source and accepted masters
acceptance_criteria: Strict versioned scene subset rejects unsupported shapes, animation, rigging and physics rather than dropping them.
Actual Blender background build produces separate editable objects in .blend, self-contained .glb and four rendered views; output geometry budgets and export/reimport are measured.
Official MCP SDK stdio initialize/tools calls run; bounded asynchronous jobs have cancellation, timeout, one worker per configured root and verified cache.
Missing or changed source/artifacts/review invalidates evidence; missing visual review is NOT_REVIEWED and never auto-PASS.
Separate critic can record per-object repair instructions and at most three repair revisions change only failing objects.
Static GLB provider matches V4 group/objects/update(absoluteSeconds)/dispose; full V4 film rendering remains NOT_TESTED unless separately exercised.
Record source baseline, exact environment, tests, timings, independent review and all unverified target-PC steps.
verification: Official MCP client smoke builds the authored fixture, polls, exports manifest and verifies a warm cache hit.
node --test tools/local_3d_mcp/adapter/test/*.test.mjs with real emitted GLB where supported
Independent code and actual-image review; no user-art approval inferred.
Separate V4 verifier: real installed Remotion/Three, native stills, hidden-asset control and repeated-frame SHA-256; original V4 sources unchanged.
human_gates: Human art acceptance before using proof as approved production asset; no automatic production approval.
No GitHub push/merge, publishing, persistent public server or paid API action in this task.
dependencies: Blender executable already present on target
risks: DevSpace connection intermittent; source materialization and target execution must be verified independently.
Procedural recipes cover static props/terrain only, not arbitrary image-to-3D, rigging, cloth, mocap or a completed DR.KHO episode.
No local vision model bundled; visual judgment is performed by a separate reviewing agent using rendered evidence.
Source snapshot is not a Git checkout; no .git initialization or remote write is implied.
notes: User request on 11 November 2026 explicitly authorizes a local independent headless MCP. This is additive; no existing UG-IR contract or Harness V4 checker is relaxed. Accepted on 11 November 2026 for local static v0.1 after Independent Reviewer ACCEPT. The two open-proof launchers are bounded convenience entrypoints for the authorized local installation. Current implementation be73aee29b30ee1f47664ed6dafb8e983022f74d5e90b6c86083d0dbec6dcaf3. Human art acceptance and full-episode integration are outside this acceptance.
